desc: What each crowd-control status forbids a Hunter (CcLockout, scripts/combat/cc_lockout.gd; table and sources in docs/COMBAT.md). Acts: move (walk and air control), dash (Shift), lmb (weapon), abil (RMB, E, R), travel (an ability that moves the caster), jump, glide, crouch, item (a belt item: drink, repair kit). Slow, knock-up, Static and Chill forbid nothing, so they have no row.
